goal: Security finding SLA gate: release blocked while findings are past their remediation deadline.
use: Security finding SLA gate: release blocked while findings are past their remediation deadline. Use when a release is planned while findings are open.

steps.note: List open findings with their severity and age.
Set the deadlines. Each severity has a remediation time limit.
Set the rule. A release with findings past deadline does not pass.
Check the exceptions. Each overdue finding needs an approved extension.
Report. The overdue findings, the release decision and the owners.
